guard: a report written to a real terminal fits that terminal's width: a table where it fits, one labeled record per row where it does not
why: Only a real terminal reports a width, so only the pty suite can show a report reads it. The report child imports the workspace build, so the mutation rebuilds it and the restore rebuilds it back.

mutations.name: a report ignores the terminal's width
mutations.expectRed: a report on a 20-column terminal is one labeled record
mutations.cell: a report on a 20-column terminal is one labeled record
